name: codex-opencode-adapter
description: Adapter service that translates codex app-server JSON-RPC to OpenCode HTTP/SSE API

scripts.package:tar: bun run compile && mkdir -p dist/package && cp dist/codex-opencode-adapter dist/package/ && cp scripts/start.sh dist/package/ && chmod +x dist/package/start.sh && cd dist/package && tar czf ../codex-opencode-adapter-$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')-$(uname -m).tar.gz *
scripts.package:dmg: bun run compile && mkdir -p dist/Codex.app/Contents/MacOS dist/Codex.app/Contents/Resources && cp scripts/Info.plist dist/Codex.app/Contents/ && cp scripts/codex-launcher dist/Codex.app/Contents/MacOS/ && cp dist/codex-opencode-adapter dist/Codex.app/Contents/MacOS/ && chmod +x dist/Codex.app/Contents/MacOS/codex-launcher && cd dist && hdiutil create -volname Codex -srcfolder Codex.app -ov -format UDZO Codex.dmg
